generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style shows two happy yellow emojis with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills. One emoji is facing forward, and the other is facing away from the viewer as if looking in a mirror. Both emojis have a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils. The emoji facing forward has eyes looking slightly upward, and the emoji facing away has the back of its head visible. Both have thick, curved black eyebrows raised in a happy expression and a wide, curved black line indicating a smile on the forward-facing emoji. Both emojis have a small, rounded body with two muscular arms raised outwards and bent at the elbows, with hands open in a cheerful gesture. Below the torso are two muscular legs with feet pointing outwards. A flat black garment, resembling underwear bottoms with bold black outlines, is worn low on each emoji's body. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the emojis.
